microbenchmark.scope: Read-only component microbenchmark, alternating order, 20 warmups, 500 samples each; excludes notification delivery, UI, async scheduling and physical power changes.

current_process_sample.scope: Current installed processes only; no matched pre-change idle measurement.

limits: No physical charger disconnect test in this run.
